note:
ASPEN practice tool: choosing between oral diet, oral nutrition supplements and enteral nutrition for the oncology patient. Its Table 1 maps a treatment-related symptom -- mucositis, nausea, dysphagia, early satiety -- to the feeding route that survives it.

That table is the operational half of the nutrition tranche: ESPEN says a malnourished patient facing major surgery needs support, and this says by which route given what the patient can actually swallow.

default.note: Feeding route follows the symptom and the gut, not the tumour setting. Serves supportive_care throughout: Choosing a feeding route given the symptom in the way.
